"The antennas settled where the fish came up, and she does not qualify that result." -> "The antennas settled the question of where the fish came up, and she does not qualify that result." (passage, paragraph 5, third sentence - the fleet-repair-2 replacement sentence itself)

justification: MAJOR, in the repair window and missed by the round that edited the sentence. The q2 option-B rationale renders the passage's jet geometry backwards. The passage says 'at April flows the jet from one notch reaches the wall of the next', and since water discharges through a notch into the pool BELOW and crosses it to the downstream wall, the jet ends at the wall below its notch. The rationale says it carries 'as far as the wall above it', where 'it' resolves to 'each notch' - and a notch, being a cut in the top of a cross-wall, has no wall above it in any case. Under every available parse the preposition is reversed, and the sentence is doing the work of explaining why the pools give no rest, so the error sits on the thing being taught. fleet-repair-2 rewrote this sentence for register ('The passage is flat about it' -> 'blunt') and left the reversal standing; it also touches content, so the integrated-review gate should confirm the fix. MINOR, repair-introduced. Paragraph 5's replacement sentence garden-paths: the passage has already put the antennas on the riverbed as physical objects - 'Two antennas lay on the apron at the weir's foot, one each side; a third in the pass mouth' - so 'The antennas settled where the fish came up' reads for a beat as the antennas coming to rest at the place the fish used. The epistemic reading is recovered by 'that result' in the next clause, so this is minor, but the previous wording ('is not in dispute') was replaced precisely to remove a cross-unit collision and the replacement introduced an ambiguity of its own. Any fix must be re-run through the n-gram screen that motivated the original edit - that is G-REGISTER's measurement, not mine. MINOR, in the rewritten q4-A paragraph: the rationale calls the event 'the flood' twice, while both the passage ('A spate in February') and the option it now faces ('the February spate') call it a spate; a spate is a sharp rise, not necessarily an overtopping, and the rationale should hold the option's own noun. RATIONALE-TO-OPTION SYNC, all fifteen distractor paragraphs checked and all correct, including the three rebuilt options: q1-C's paragraph describes the chub-recorded-as-dace claim, q4-A's describes a force attribution and refutes it with the same-water control, and q4-D's describes the whole-pass overreach and refutes it on the nine-wall count. The q2-A diagnosis label reads 'A flattens the temperature split', which is the repaired and now correct description of an option that equalises the two groups rather than reversing them. Hunt-list otherwise clean: BrE held throughout every layer (metres, millimetres, hardbacked, no -ize forms, no AmE); no Swedish-interference prepositions; no false friends; no ESL or AI tells; register is mid-Atlantic river reportage against the ELF corpus portrait; stems are content-anchored, none generic. Key and option language is grammatical and unambiguous as language in all five questions.

findings: "Svaret ligger i fyra uppgifter som texten aldrig räknar samman" -> "Svaret ligger i uppgifter som texten aldrig räknar samman" (q1 rationale, key paragraph, first sentence) - OPTIONAL, does not drive the verdict
justification: Read two sentences either side of every fleet-repair-2 span; nothing introduced, and two spans improved. PARAGRAPH 5, 'Alla som vill stå' -> 'Alla som vill ha plats': the stå pile-up drops from five forms in two consecutive sentences to four, and the remaining four are inherent to the subject ('kastanjerna står där de står' is a deliberate idiom, and 'stå på torget' is the only Swedish for holding a market pitch), so the avoidable one is the one that went. The change also tightens the lexical chain, since 'ha plats' now answers to 'sökte plats' and 'Fyra platser blev lediga' two sentences on, and it still does its load-bearing job of making the seventy-four all applicants rather than only the new ones. PARAGRAPH 7, 'jag tänker inte påstå' -> 'jag skriver inte under på': idiomatic debattprosa, negation correctly placed after the finite verb in the main clause, and the neighbouring subordinate clauses ('att det ordnar sig av sig självt', 'eftersom folk måste hinna vänja sig') take no negation, so BIFF is not in play. The new wording is a firmer disavowal than the old one but does not move the key: option A still needs only that she concede the lean years and refuse to pretend they resolve themselves, and both halves survive. CODA, 'ståndsraderna' -> 'ståndraderna': correct, and the form the gate itself offered. The -s- fogemorfem on stånd belongs to the social-estate sense (ståndssamhälle, ståndsmässig) and pointed away from the market stall; the joint-free compound follows the husrad/trädrad pattern and is an unobjectionable ad-hoc coinage. The definite 'ståndraderna' without a prior mention of rows is licensed by bridging from 'Fältet är utstakat för hundratrettio stånd' one paragraph earlier. THE SIX RECAST RATIONALE SENTENCES all now run as prose rather than as bracketed marking-key labels, all are grammatical, and each still names the fault it labelled: 'A är en regel som låter självklar men som inte står i texten', 'B har rätt siffra och fel sakförhållande', 'C vänder företrädet åt fel håll', 'B tar bara med halva kravet', 'C läser medgivandet som en slutsats', 'D är det alternativ texten uttryckligen säger nej till' (object-relative 'som' correctly omitted). C's closing sentence no longer repeats 'företrädet' and now uses a clean cleft. In q2's key paragraph 'skriver' -> 'säger' correctly avoids colliding with the passage's new 'skriver under'. RATIONALE-TO-OPTION SYNC: all six distractor paragraphs describe the option they face, all numbers reconcile with the passage, and gender and reference are correct throughout ('den' for plats 1 and for dörren, both utrum). THE ONE RECORDED ITEM is a readability nit in recast text: 'fyra uppgifter' opens an arithmetic rationale whose subject matter includes 'Fyra platser blev lediga', so the numeral briefly reads as the vacancy count. The count of four facts is accurate, so this is optional. Hunt-list otherwise clean: no verb calque, no passive infinitive in the N-att-V frame, BIFF correct at every subordinate clause I checked, en/ett and definiteness correct, no non-words, no register break, numerals spelled out consistently in prose with digits reserved for identifiers and years, and the byline and title frame intact.

Read two sentences either side of the single fleet-repair-2 span; nothing introduced, and both faults the round targeted are gone. THE CODA, 'Ingen har tagit ut kopparna' -> 'Ingen har tagit ut kopparna ur det': the valency is restored, since Swedish takes 'ta ut något UR något', and the reference is now unambiguous on gender - 'det' is neuter and resolves to 'Glasskåpet' in the immediately preceding sentence, while the competing 'hallen' is utrum and cannot take it. The closing 'där' now lands on the cabinet rather than on the hall, because the cabinet has just been named as the container in the same sentence; the earlier 'där' in 'fick stå i hallen, där det är för stort' is a bound relative adverb and does not compete with a free deictic. Read aloud with the two sentences on either side, the coda works: 'Farmor flyttade till en tvåa i stan när hon blev ensam. Glasskåpet följde med och fick stå i hallen, där det är för stort. Ingen har tagit ut kopparna ur det, och ingen har sagt att de ska stå där.' The tense ladder across those three sentences - preterite, then present for the standing state, then perfect for the two omissions - is the standard memoir move and is not a drift. The 'Ingen ... och ingen' anaphora is deliberate and carries the close. No option, prompt or rationale quotes this sentence, so nothing downstream moved, which I verified by reading both rationales in full. RATIONALE-TO-OPTION SYNC: both rationales describe the options they face, and every paragraph reference in them is correct against the shipped bytes - the admission criterion is in stycke 2, the television material and the coffin sentence are in stycke 5, and the soffgrupp chain the q2-B paragraph traces (stycke 1, farstun in stycke 4, 'samma soffgrupp' in stycke 5) checks out at all three places.
